summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of the NEW CreateTrackerWizard multi-step feature. All 5 wizard steps working correctly: Basic Setup (name, mandate, template mode), Column Selection (58 columns, 11 categories, search, alphabetical ordering), Custom Columns (add/remove with field types including dropdown), Required Fields (toggle switches), Review (summary display). Backend APIs all passing (8/8 tests). Full create flow successfully creates tracker and redirects to spreadsheet view.

Good use of data-testid attributes throughout for testing
Upload flow (UPLOAD_STEPS) implemented but not fully tested - consider adding E2E test for file upload mode
Step indicator allows clicking completed steps to navigate back - nice UX
